pages.text: $(li)$(bold)The Harbinger$() and $(bold)Ignis$(): $(bold)Arcane industry$(), enchantment as a factory, dragon's breath as a fluid.$(li)$(bold)Ender Guardian$() (the End), $(bold)Scylla$() (warm ocean) and the $(bold)Warden$() (the deep dark): $(bold)Ender logistics$(), ender chests, portable interfaces, item vaults.
$(bold)Hovering Inferno$() holds loot, not knowledge: the best artifacts in the Nether.$(br2)Two Blueprints at the end of the world, and both of them about moving things.
